programme.desc: The story is about a girls' hostel where girls from different cities come to get an education. The hostel has strict rules and regulations, the credit for which goes to the warden of the hostel, Shaista Naz. Maha is also among the girls who came here with the dream of success in her eyes. programme.title: Ishq Ek Gunah
programme.desc: Kareem, a successful businessman, lives a blissful life with his beautiful wife and grown-up children. But fate has a way of turning happiness into turmoil in a single moment. One tragic day, Kareem’s loyal driver sacrifices his life in a fatal accident while saving Kareem. Shaken and indebted, Kareem takes it upon himself to honor this ultimate sacrifice. He brings the driver’s grieving wife, Fatima, and their young daughter, Nasreen, into his own home. Nasreen, a strikingly beautiful yet ambitious young woman, is quickly captivated and consumed by the wealth and grandeur of Kareem’s household. Envy takes root, and she begins to plot her way into Kareem’s heart, weaving schemes to replace the harmony of his family with her own desires.

programme.title: Rishtey Series
programme.desc: The theme of our special stories series is Relationships. Relationships without which our life is incomplete. Relationships are the asset of our life that binds us together in the rope of feelings and emotions. Relationships are the blessings of God that we do not choose by ourselves. Throughout our life, there are many colors of relationships like love, hate, friendship, feeling, trust, and every color of relationships is special. And you will see all these special colors in the series 'Rishtay' on AAN TV.

programme.title: Mera Susraal
programme.desc: It is a story of Dua who marries Nadeem Ahmed out of love and enters a household where her sisters-in-law, elder and younger, engulf their lives in the greed for wealth, poisoning the happiness of Nadeem Ahmed and Dua's joy-filled life. The elder and younger sisters always assert their dominance over Nadeem Ahmed, and he, in turn, obeys their every command. In reality, both these sisters never wanted Nadeem Ahmed to marry Dua, but Nadeem Ahmed fell in love with Dua, and they got married, dreaming of starting a new life together, which remained incomplete due to the selfishness of the sisters.

programme.title: Muqaam
programme.desc: Amber and Sehar are very close friends. Amber is a simple, homely girl, while Sehar is modern, bold, and a little selfish, driven by her love for wealth. Amber gets married to Hassan, a handsome young man who believes that an ideal life partner should be modern and bold. Although Hassan marries Amber due to his family's choice, when he meets Sehar, he sees his ideal partner in her. Hassan's admiration and constant praise for Sehar greatly please her, and she completely forgets that she is crossing boundaries with her best friend's husband. Amber's simplicity and naïve nature create the space for Hassan and Sehar to grow closer, until Hassan even decides to marry Sehar as his second wife. Will Amber and Sehar's friendship turn into hatred? By rejecting Amber's love, will Hassan openly confess his love for Sehar? When respect disappears from relationships, how can anyone find their true place?

programme.title: 'Allo 'Allo!
programme.desc: General von Klinkerhoffen, concerned about Berlin's intervention in the case of Herr Flick's disappearance, develops a cunning plan.Disguised as partisans, Colonel and Lieutenant Gruber free Flick from the dungeon, then fall into an ambush where Flick is shot.The colonel does not like this plan and develops his own - wearing Gestapo coats, the colonel and Gruber go to the dungeon to free Flick.There they find René, who, according to Helga's plan, came to the dungeon disguised as Himmler, also to free Flick.Unfortunately, no one predicted that Flick would come up with the idea that René would replace him.Captain Bertorelli moves into the room above the café.

programme.title: Solar System
programme.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.Additionally, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programme.title: Ben Fogle's Race for the Nile
Joanna Lumley's Spice Trail Adventure
programme.desc: Actress Joanna Lumley, known from the films "Absolutely Fabulous" and "The Wolf of Wall Street", goes on an expedition to discover the origins of spices.It follows two continents in the footsteps of pharaohs, crusaders and rulers.He visits the Indonesian Banda Islands, which were once the only place on Earth where nutmeg grew.He also visits Madagascar, the place of the largest vanilla cultivation.It also goes to India and the Middle East.He realizes that for hundreds of years, the East and the West have been linked by the spice trade.

programme.title: Gordon Buchanan: My Epic Camel Adventure
programme.desc: Scottish filmmaker and TV presenter Gordon Buchanan begins his expedition through the Gobi Desert.He decides to do it on a camel, a traditional Mongolian means of transport.An animal adapted to living in a dry and hot climate will help it survive in the wilderness, rocky plains, desert dunes and the dangerous Bumbat Mountain.Gordon wants to get to know his animal companions better.It provides them with food and benefits from the warmth of their fur.He also benefits from the hospitality of nomads who live a wandering lifestyle.The journey helps him understand that climate change has direct consequences not only for animals, but also for people who inhabit the vast steppes.

programme.title: Serengeti
programme.desc: Viewers will see up close the everyday life of animals living in the pristine areas of the African Serengeti Park.In the next season of the nature series, they will learn the fate of new characters.The paradise landscapes of the Serengeti plain are just an illusion.There are many dangers and challenging days for the animals there.Kali the lioness and Bakari the baboon seem safe in their rock hideouts.On all sides, they are motivated by competition.Duma the cheetah faces his fate, and Mafuta the hippopotamus befriends Magamba the crocodile on the river.

programme.title: The World's Most Scenic Railway Journeys
programme.desc: The creators of the series go on a train journey to various places around the world.During each expedition, they meet people who live in specific areas or work on the most unique railway routes.They will also discover the wonders of nature that can be admired from the train windows.They will talk to engineers responsible for maintaining the lines and historians who will talk about the circumstances of their construction and the difficulties their builders faced.Viewers will be able to admire the landscapes of Norway, New Zealand, Canada, Switzerland, Wales and Spain.

programme.title: The Jennings vs Alzheimer's
programme.desc: The documentary presents the history of the Jennings family, thanks to which it was possible to confirm the heredity of Alzheimer's disease.It all started with research conducted by the University College in London.In 1986, Professor John Hardy launched a newsletter that sought to collect reports from families with two or more cases of Alzheimer's disease.The team received many messages, but it was the one from Carol Jennings that caught their attention.In the letter, the woman described in detail the stories of her loved ones - her father, brother and sister.Each of them started showing symptoms after the age of 50.Thanks to the information provided, scientists managed to make a breakthrough in the field.

programme.desc: Viewers will see up close the everyday life of animals living in the pristine areas of the African Serengeti Park.In the next season of the nature series, they will learn the fate of new characters.The paradise landscapes of the Serengeti plain are just an illusion.There are many dangers and challenging days for the animals there.Kali the lioness and Bakari the baboon seem safe in their rock hideouts.On all sides, they are motivated by competition.Duma the cheetah faces his fate, and Mafuta the hippopotamus befriends Magamba the crocodile on the river.

programme.desc: Another season of a crime series set in the fictional British county of Midsomer.In this seemingly peaceful area, whose inhabitants form closed communities, people die surprisingly often.The circumstances in which the murders occur are investigated by Chief Inspector John Barnaby (Neil Dudgeon), who replaced his cousin, Tom.The investigations conducted by him and his assistants often reveal the secrets of the inhabitants of Midsomer.It turns out that the owners of well-kept houses and afternoon tea patrons are no strangers to sick ambitions, jealousy and hatred that force them to commit cruel acts.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient \"Wall Street\" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history.\nMaster Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the \"king of brocades.\" It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as \"weaving through the warp and cutting the weft\"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous \"mala\" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of \"lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.2
programme.desc: Sichuan's western mountains are a shield safeguarding a true national treasure: the Chengdu Plain, China's very own land of plenty. Join us as we dive from high plateaus into deep gorges, scale snow peaks, and follow rivers in pursuit of an engineering marvel bequeathed by the ancients..

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since.\nKleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: \"Foodwise\" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. \nFrom the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. \nIn this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. \nDive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of \"World Capital of Stone Carving,\" awarded by the World Crafts Council.\nThe county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview \"the Monkey Father\"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview \"the Monkey Father\"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all.

programme.title: Aerial China II-2 Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip.

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous \"Crossing the Bridge\" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.desc: In Foshan, kung fu is daily life. Kleber visits Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut masters, tries traditional massage and lion dance, explores lion head craftsmanship — Lingnan charm of kung fu rooted in local soil.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber studies Taiji with master Chen Ziqiang in Chenjiagou. Gentle movements with combat power. He tries practical training, visits historic sites, and feels Taiji’s folk roots and local attachment.

programme.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.3
programme.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Join Tianran and Hannah in Shantou, Guangdong, as they explore the world of kungfu tea and its inseparable link to the local food. After sampling the finest teas the old city has to offer, they’ll try their hand at traditional crafts like inlaid porcelain and red peach pastries, all while taking in Shantou's coastal scenery and vibrant culture.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: This time Tianran and Hannah are in the scenic city of Shaoguan in northern Guangdong, where northern and southern culinary traditions converge. There, they’ll sample rare teas from the Danxia landscape, savor mountain-grown dishes, and visit the great Hakka enclosures, learning how the history of migration has shaped the way people eat and drink. After trying their hand at making ancient-style rice noodles, they end their journey at a thousand-year-old temple, where the spirit of Zen tea brings their exploration to a peaceful close.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the \"Summer Davos\" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. \n\nThis special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called \"Manluanzhan\" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm?\n\nIn Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN as we reveal how a drop of crude oil transforms into our clothes, uncovering a complex and fascinating journey of the textile and garment manufacturing process. \nFollow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm?\n\nIn Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development.\nIn this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN as we reveal how a drop of crude oil transforms into our clothes, uncovering a complex and fascinating journey of the textile and garment manufacturing process. \nFollow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Detroit Hives
programme.desc: Detroit Hives follows Tim Paule and Nicole Lindsey, a young couple from East Detroit, who are working hard to bring diversity to the field of beekeeping and create opportunities for young Detroit natives to overcome adversity. It is estimated that Detroit has well over 90,000 empty housing lots to date. In an effort to address this issue, Tim and Nicole have been purchasing vacant lots and converting them into bee farms. Detroit Hives explores the importance of bringing diversity to beekeeping and rebuilding inner-city communities one hive at a time.

programme.title: Switch On The Series
programme.desc: Visit the Maasai savannah of Kenya, Africa's largest slum and its newest hydroelectric dam. Journey into the coal mines and power plants of growing Vietnam. Cross Nepal with an environmental health scientist, studying people's transition from the most dangerous cooking fuel, killing millions a year, to the safest. And bring solar electricity, for the first time ever, to the Arhuaco people of Northern Colombia. Watch this 7-part series, based on and expanded from the celebrated global energy documentary Switch On– a spectacular, unexpected journey to know and understand the issues driving energy development around the world.

programme.title: Sanctuary - Chimp Haven

programme.title: We Unite
programme.desc: We Unite - The 12-minute film 'We Unite' is a window into the lives of two organic farmers and the reasons they join the yearly 'We are Fed-Up' demonstration in Germany. Along with hundreds of other farmers, they drive their tractors into the heart of Berlin where they unite with thousands of citizens calling for a better food and farming system for all. Carlo Horn and Hanna Erz talk about why they farm organically, the impact it has on soils and yield, and how, even in times of drought, they are still able to harvest crops. They highlight the need for sustainable food systems that give farmers access to land, protect the environment, pay fair prices and provide good food for all.

programme.title: Tapish
programme.desc: Shahzer is a young heir to immense wealth, known for his strong, dominating personality and short temper. Despite his privileged background, his anger and behavior often create distance between him and others. Shifa is a strong, responsible young woman who quietly carries the burden of her family while holding onto her dreams through patience and sacrifice. Maaz, Shifa’s cousin and fiancé, shares a close bond with her, and they are already engaged in a relationship built on family trust and mutual understanding. Fate takes an unexpected turn when Shahzer crosses paths with Shifa and feels an unexplainable pull toward her—completely unaware that she is already engaged to Maaz, his closest friend. This hidden truth soon becomes the center of emotional conflict, testing friendship, love, and loyalty. Will Shahzer ever get Shifa, or is she already beyond his reach? Will Maaz discover Shahzer’s feelings for Shifa? Will love win for Maaz and Shifa, even with Shahzer around? Geo Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Milkiyat
programme.desc: Soha, a young woman raised by her grandfather after losing her parents, lives a simple yet strong life. She is happily married to Rafay, a loving and caring husband. However, her world falls apart when Rafay dies in a tragic accident. Zaviyar is a wealthy and arrogant man who has everything in life except true love. He was once deeply in love but after being betrayed, he no longer believes in relationships and keeps his distance from emotions. Fate brings Soha and Zaviyar together, but they are unaware of their true connection at first. Zaviyar is burdened by guilt from a mistake in his past, and in an attempt to ease it, he begins helping Soha and her family. Over time, this brings him closer to her, and he gradually falls in love. Will Zaviyar get his love? Why is Soha not convinced by Zaviyar’s love? Can Zaviyar escape the guilt that follows him every step? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Sanwal Yaar Piya
programme.desc: Sanwal Yaar Piya is a tale of love, fate, and the tangled lives of three individuals—Sanwal, Aliyaar, and Piya. Their destinies collide amidst challenges of loyalty, sacrifice, and a complicated past. Sanwal, a self-made man, and Aliyaar, a privileged son of a powerful figure, both fall for Piya, whose father hides dark secrets. In a world of deceit and power struggles, the trio must confront their emotions and pasts. As they navigate betrayal and power, their strength, loyalty, and resolve to fight for what is right are put to the test. Between Sanwal and Aliyaar, who will Piya choose? What dark secret is Piya’s father hiding? Will Sanwal lose to Aliyaar because of his wealth and power? How will the past shape the lives of Sanwal, Yaar, and Piya? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Shaidai
programme.desc: Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test. Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Zabt
programme.desc: Ayla, a beautiful young girl, is deeply in love with her cousin Ehtisham. But their love is caught in a long-standing family conflict, where their mothers’ hatred keeps them apart at every step. Unseen and unheard, Aoun—a quiet young man living only with his grandmother—carries feelings for Ayla, though she has never noticed him. Sometimes, fate brings two hearts close only to pull them apart again. Their love is tested by family conflicts and hidden betrayals, breaking what once felt strong and real. In the middle of this pain, a broken heart finds comfort in the one who has always loved silently. But this connection is not fully accepted by the heart, as emotions remain confused and uncertain. Will Aoun ever express his love to Ayla? Can Ayla and Ehtisham stay together despite their family conflict? Will Ayla ever realize who truly cares for her? Geo Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? What does life look like for Elif and Sayhaan’s father when the person they tried to protect can no longer look them in the eye? Director &

programme.title: Behkaway
programme.desc: In a world where desires blur the lines between right and wrong, one man’s pursuit of happiness sets off a chain of irreversible consequences. Zubair, a middle-aged man hardened by ego and entitlement, rules over his household with an iron hand. His wife, Zeenat, bears the weight of his injustices in silence, enduring not only his coldness but the cruelty of his mother and sister. Despite her unwavering love and devotion, Zeenat receives nothing but pain in return. But everything begins to shift when Zubair encounters Sitara, a young, captivating woman whose charm ignites a dangerous spark within him. Driven by selfish desires, Zubair makes a decision that sets off a ripple effect far beyond his control. Will Zubair abandon Zeenat after meeting Sitara? Will his decision have consequences for his family? And will Sitara prove to be a blessing or a nightmare in disguise for him? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Baylagaam
programme.desc: The story centers around Ramsha, a young girl and the only child of her loving parents, Sajid and Mehnaz. Raised with affection and no restrictions, Ramsha enjoys unlimited internet access, which leads to her spending an excessive time on social media, quickly becoming her hobby. As her fascination with social media intensifies, Ramsha's hobby evolves into an all-consuming passion for fame, prompting her to take extreme measures. During her relentless pursuit of stardom, she crosses paths with Afnan, the son of the influential businessman Qasim Ali. While Afnan, who holds affection for his paternal cousin Aleezay, views Ramsha as a source of amusement, she misinterprets their friendship as love. Disheartened by her failed search for love, Ramsha turns towards fame. Ramsha's unwavering quest for popularity propels her onto a challenging path, causing turmoil within her family. As her popularity soars, she becomes increasingly distant from her loved ones, leading her life down a tumultuous road, where she discovers the other side of fame many people are unaware of. Along this journey, she encounters Afnan once more, but circumstances have taken a different turn. Will Ramsha achieve the fame she so desperately desires? Will her pursuit bring dire consequences? Can she find contentment in fame instead of love? And will Ramsha's parents have to bear the consequences of her passion?

programme.title: Pehli Barish
programme.desc: Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself. Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred. Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago. Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds? GEO & 7th Sky Entertainment presentation

Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson. Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed. Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in. What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Humrahi
programme.desc: What begins as a series of light-hearted yet unpleasant encounters between Sayhaan and Elif eventually blossoms into an unexpected and deep-rooted love. Just as they begin to find their footing together, the life of Sayhaan Ghazi is suddenly upended by a storm he did not create. When an unforeseen crisis strikes, the two pillars of his existence—his devoted love, Elif, and his formidable father—are forced to face an impossible ultimatum. Driven by a desperate, protective instinct, they make a difficult choice to shield him from a reality they believe would be his undoing. However, this well-intentioned sacrifice triggers a catastrophic chain of events, turning their home into a place of chilling distance and lifelong regret. It is a haunting exploration of how the choices made for those we love can ultimately become the very walls that permanently divide a family. Will Sayhaan’s journey forward be defined by the choices others made, or will he find a way to reclaim his own destiny? What does life look like for Elif and Sayhaan’s father when the person they tried to protect can no longer look them in the eye? Director &

programme.title: Zabt
programme.desc: Ayla, a beautiful young girl, is deeply in love with her cousin Ehtisham. But their love is caught in a long-standing family conflict, where their mothers’ hatred keeps them apart at every step. Unseen and unheard, Aoun—a quiet young man living only with his grandmother—carries feelings for Ayla, though she has never noticed him. Sometimes, fate brings two hearts close only to pull them apart again. Their love is tested by family conflicts and hidden betrayals, breaking what once felt strong and real. In the middle of this pain, a broken heart finds comfort in the one who has always loved silently. But this connection is not fully accepted by the heart, as emotions remain confused and uncertain. Will Aoun ever express his love to Ayla? Can Ayla and Ehtisham stay together despite their family conflict? Will Ayla ever realize who truly cares for her? Geo Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Milkiyat
programme.desc: Soha, a young woman raised by her grandfather after losing her parents, lives a simple yet strong life. She is happily married to Rafay, a loving and caring husband. However, her world falls apart when Rafay dies in a tragic accident. Zaviyar is a wealthy and arrogant man who has everything in life except true love. He was once deeply in love but after being betrayed, he no longer believes in relationships and keeps his distance from emotions. Fate brings Soha and Zaviyar together, but they are unaware of their true connection at first. Zaviyar is burdened by guilt from a mistake in his past, and in an attempt to ease it, he begins helping Soha and her family. Over time, this brings him closer to her, and he gradually falls in love. Will Zaviyar get his love? Why is Soha not convinced by Zaviyar’s love? Can Zaviyar escape the guilt that follows him every step? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Hasna Mana Hai
programme.desc: There is a locality in the old city of Lahore where a young man (Host: Tabish Hashmi) has come to reside from Karachi. He is the guy who has reside in Canada too, so there is a double introduction with his name. This locality is basically a pulse of society in that almost all the segments are presents. The young man (Host) tries to understand the eccentric behavior of the people around and in doing so inadvertently offers himself to mock at. The host brings to light the fact that the morals are customs more preached than practiced while traditions are customs more practiced than preached. Gradually the host will lay bare the sensibility, psyche and sensitivity of different characters thus giving the viewers insight into the show storyline. The viewers come to know of perplexing paradoxes in the funniest way possible. In every new episode the locality is entrapped into a tricky situation which they are struggling to come out of employing street smart tactics. Notwithstanding with the fact that they condemn every other person, institution, norm and policy of the government but they exactly do contrarily to what they profess. The issues of the community revolve around small scale corruption, partisanship, political misadventures, jealousy, interference, snobbery, belittling others. They keep taunting one another using tongue in cheek remarks thus manifesting a past perennially plagued with street power struggle, political affiliation, and proclivity for easy money and predisposition to the influence. There are two different strands lurking parallel to each other in the show. The host has to entertain the audience by introducing them to socio-political anecdotes, guests, short skits, weird people, achievers, trivial but tantalizing smaller wins, social eccentricity, literary uniqueness, cultural exclusivity, musical performance, parodying, stand up comedy etc and still the other strand runs on the floor as the main subject of the show - the drama being played out by the permanent characters of the show. These permanent characters are Pehalwan, Policeman, Professor, Pehalwan's daughter, a wannabe actress, a foreign returned Pakistani, Pehalwan's wife, a shop keeper, a poet, a fatman (an idle youth), a girl singer. The show will be divided into different segments but this segmentation is not conventional. The segments will only be announced in terms of the introduction of characters or performance if need be. Usually the characters will come on their own giving an impression as if they are unwanted though the host is quite familiar with them and poses as if their forced entry is not highly welcomed.

programme.title: Sanwal Yaar Piya
programme.desc: Sanwal Yaar Piya is a tale of love, fate, and the tangled lives of three individuals—Sanwal, Aliyaar, and Piya. Their destinies collide amidst challenges of loyalty, sacrifice, and a complicated past. Sanwal, a self-made man, and Aliyaar, a privileged son of a powerful figure, both fall for Piya, whose father hides dark secrets. In a world of deceit and power struggles, the trio must confront their emotions and pasts. As they navigate betrayal and power, their strength, loyalty, and resolve to fight for what is right are put to the test. Between Sanwal and Aliyaar, who will Piya choose? What dark secret is Piya’s father hiding? Will Sanwal lose to Aliyaar because of his wealth and power? How will the past shape the lives of Sanwal, Yaar, and Piya? 7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programme.title: Geo Entertainment
programme.desc: Geo Entertainment provides Pakistani dramas, family serials, reality shows, and general entertainment programming.

programme.title: Fitoor
programme.desc: Fitoor narrates a love story that transcends above all as a person in love is bound to forget about the worries of the past and the uncertainty of the future. Despite being a successful architect, Haider feels lacking in his love life as he is still living with the memories of his love interest. On the other hand, Dilnasheen who hails from a middle-class background is deeply in love with her best friend’s brother Hamza and both vows to be with each other forever without realizing the difficulties they might have to overcome. Living in her present, Dilnasheen’s life takes an unfortunate turn when she crosses paths with Haider. Will Haider and Dilnasheen be able to forget their past and move on in their lives? Or will the past pay them a visit when they begin to settle down? Will Haider and Dilnasheen be able to distinguish between their past and present?

programme.title: Kurlus Osman
programme.desc: The series focuses on the life of Osman Bey, the son of Ertugrul Gazi and the founder of the Ottoman Empire. Osman begins his journey by forming a friendship with Yorgopolos and the Kayi tribe expands its influence further during the reign of Osman Ghazi, but some problems hinder Osman and he must solve it. Osman faces many enemies and traitors in his quest and overcomes the obstacles. Osman also marries his love, Bala, amid his reign. He fulfills his missions with the help of his loyal companions, family, and friends.

programme.title: Tere Mere Sapnay
programme.desc: Amal, a beautiful and charming girl resides with her father, uncle, aunt, and cousin. Amal exudes confidence and possesses a resilient personality. On the other side is Azlan, a young and attractive orphan, who shares his home with his uncle, aunt, and cousin. His visit to Amal’s city, initially for a wedding, takes an unexpected turn, leading to a fateful encounter between Azlan and Amal. As their connection deepens, Azlan and Amal find themselves falling in love. However, their budding romance faces an unforeseen challenge as unresolved issues from the past resurface, casting a shadow over the path of their love. Is there a chance for Amal and Azlan to build a future together? What events from the past will influence their future? Will the families of Amal and Azlan play a supportive role in bringing them together?

programme.title: Bojh
programme.desc: “Bojh” depicts our society’s preconceived notion and false mindset that boys are an asset whereas girls are a burden to a family. “Bojh” is an effort to break this unjustified way of thinking due to which women have become a victim of prejudice in our society. Bojh is based on the story of a middle-class family where the father (Qavi Khan) of four daughters and a son has imposed restrictions on blooming of his vibrant daughters and he thinks that education is of no importance for daughters however, he has given a free hand to his only son. Just due to the fear of heavy dowry, he gets 2 of his daughters engaged to his nephews who are not even capable of taking good care of the girls and then girls alone have to face a lot of hardships and struggles after marriage. Cast: Qavi Khan, Alyy Khan, Neelum Munir, Nausheen Shah, Maria Wasti, Shahood Alvi, Syed Jibran ScriptWriter: Ghazala Aziz

programme.title: Heer Da Hero
programme.desc: Heer is a young and confident girl, who has become a TikTok star with a large following on social media. Hero, on the other hand, is a charismatic and confident man, but with a softer side that he keeps hidden. Despite their families’ long-standing feud, Heer and Hero begin to develop feelings for each other after hilarious first encounters. As they are about to navigate their growing romance, Heer is introduced to a potential partner, Zain who makes matters worse for Hero and Heer. Eventually, they find themselves on opposing sides in a highly contested community election, where both are determined to emerge victorious. Will their budding romance survive in the face of such deep-seated animosity? Can their love find a way to break the cycle of hate? And what will become of their relationship as they battle each other in the election? Whatever happens, one thing is for sure: the family feud has never been quite this ridiculous. From Heer’s vibrant personality to Hero’s ridiculous antics, this is a story that will keep you entertained throughout.

programme.title: Ghulam Bashah Sundri
programme.desc: Set in a world where emotions run deep and power defines fate, Ghulam Bashah Sundri is a gripping drama of love, rivalry, and control. As relationships are tested and loyalties begin to fracture, desire turns into conflict and hearts become battlegrounds. At the center lies a compelling love triangle that draws each character into an intense emotional, social, and personal reckoning, where every choice carries consequences.

programme.title: Maa
programme.desc: Maa is an emotional family drama about love, loss, and identity. The story follows Raaha, a lively young girl raised by her grandfather, unaware of the painful truth about her birth. Abandoned by her mother Tara to protect her, and separated from her parents due to class differences and betrayal. Will Raaha uncover the truth about her past and find the love she was denied?

programme.title: Humnava
programme.desc: Humnava is more than just a drama it’s an emotional journey through love betrayal and resilience. It tells the story of a woman whose world is shaken when the one she trusted the most breaks her heart. But this is not just her story it reflects the pain of every person who’s ever been torn between loyalty and heartbreak. As relationships are tested and conspiracies unfold Humnava shows how real love doesn’t fade it fights it survives and it rises. Through shattered trust emotional trials and inner strength this drama is a reminder that in the end truth and sincerity always win.

programme.title: Druk
programme.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programme.title: On Swift Horses
programme.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: Chicago, 1930s. At the request of Frankenstein (Christian Bale), researcher Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening) resurrects for him a woman (Jessie Buckley), a murder victim, pulled out of the grave.An odd couple like Bonny and Clyde quickly attracts trouble and has to flee the city.Detective Jake (Peter Sarsgaard) follows them, with his assistant Myrna (Penelope Cruz) helping him at every step.The revived dead woman and her companion cause chaos wherever they appear.Together they commit robberies and murders, and over time, the two outcasts develop a fiery romance.Mary Shelley, possessed by the voice of the writer, seeks destruction, but at the same time frees herself from the corset of social conventions.An ambitious reinterpretation of a horror classic with elements of Victorian horror and burlesque.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: Her
programme.desc: Los Angeles.Theodore makes a living by writing letters to order.He experiences a painful divorce from Catherine.His friend Amy supports him in difficult times.He spends his free time playing computer games and occasional dates.One day he buys a new operating system that can meet all user needs.She uses the software's capabilities by communicating with a virtual character with a sensual voice, Samantha.He quickly realizes that this cybernetic consciousness understands him perfectly.He has great knowledge, sense of humor and feelings.Theodore realizes that he has met the ideal woman.Attempts are made to create an unconventional relationship.

credits.actor: Sexy Pregnant TV Star - May Lindstrom

programme.title: Ainda Estou Aqui
programme.desc: Brazil, 1971. A military dictatorship is gaining strength in the country, and the lives of citizens are disrupted by detentions, disappearances and acts of violence.In these dangerous times, the Paiva family tries to live a peaceful life in Rio de Janeiro.Everything changes when one day the family patriarch, Rubens (Selton Mello), a former congressman, is summoned for a mysterious interrogation by military investigators.Soon, the officers arrest Eunice Paiva (Fernanda Torres), the mother of the family.She is kept in prison for 12 days and put under pressure to hand over her friends and associates accused of opposition activities.The traumatic experience becomes the beginning of Eunice's profound transformation.After leaving prison, she is forced to find herself again - she fights for the truth as an activist.Its goal is to expose the government's illegal actions and fight for justice for thousands of victims of the regime.

programme.title: Our Son
programme.desc: Nicky (Luke Evans) shares his life with Gabriel (Billy Porter), who has devoted himself to raising their son.The other father has been feeling disappointed for some time and finally files for divorce.

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: 1960s.Young Briton Jude (Jim Sturgess) goes to the United States in search of his father, whom he has never known before.The man is said to be a university lecturer.However, he turns out to be an ordinary worker.There, Jude meets a teenage American girl, Lucy (Evan Rachel Wood).They both fall in love with each other at first sight.Soon, Lucy's brother, Max (Joe Anderson), is drafted and goes to war in Vietnam.Meanwhile, Jude and Lucy, along with a group of friends and musicians, engage in anti-war activities.Their guides are: Dr. Robert (Bono) and Mr. Kite (Eddie Izzard).Together they fight for freedom of speech and civil rights.However, the tense situation is not favorable for lovers.Adversity tears them apart.They have to overcome many obstacles to be together again.The film's soundtrack included several songs by the legendary band The Beatles.The film was nominated for a Golden Globe (Best Musical) and an Oscar (Best Costume Design).

programme.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, a meteorite falls on the zoo.Thanks to him, some of the inhabitants turn into neon, jelly-like creatures with suspicious properties, and the entire zoo is thrown into chaos.The clever wolf Gracie and the haughty puma Dan, who have been out of each other's way until now, decide to put aside their personal grudges to save the animals.Together with a group of daredevils, including Frida the capybara, Felix the baboon, Ash the nervous ostrich, Xavier the lemur and the charming Hippo, they create a crazy rescue team.The Polish language version was attended by, among others:Magdalena Boczarska, Marcin Piętowski and Mateusz Banasiuk.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart) celebrates her 18th birthday.The passing moments make her realize that she will one day grow old, while her boyfriend Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson), who is a vampire, will always physically remain young.Despite this, the girl agrees to come to the party organized by the Cullen family.During her birthday party, Bella accidentally cuts her finger.At the sight of blood, one of the members of the vampire clan, Jasper (Jackson Rathbone), cannot stop feeling hungry.Unable to control himself, he attacks the girl.Edward saves his beloved, but decides not to put her in danger anymore.For her sake, he decides to leave the area.Before leaving, he tells Bella that he doesn't feel anything for her anymore.A lonely and betrayed teenager falls into depression.Only her acquaintance with a handsome Indian, Jacob Black (Taylor Lautner), helps her regain her balance.The boy falls in love with Bella, but hides his greatest secret from her.

programme.title: A Picture Of Her
programme.desc: Beth (Rhiannon Fish) works as first mate on a fishing vessel.He goes ashore for a while to take care of his aunt (Samantha Ferris), who has broken her leg.During her daily shopping, photographer Jake (Tyler Hynes) secretly takes a photo of her choosing flowers.A freelancer sends a photo of a stranger to a newspaper under a pseudonym.Some time later, Beth and Jake meet in person.They both turn out to be dog lovers, and over time they discover that they have a lot in common.The lovers' relationship is getting closer.Then Beth's photo appears on the cover of a magazine and goes viral, making her very popular.The woman wants to find the author, meanwhile Jake does not have the courage to confess the truth.

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with the progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.
